description: This PHP source file defines a helper class 'JobStatusHelper' that manages job statuses related to calendar synchronization within a scheduler system. It provides methods to construct conditions for filtering active jobs, identify specific sync jobs, and generate standardized job names for account and meeting sync operations.

classes.name: JobStatusHelper
classes.description: Helper class for managing job statuses and constructing job-related information for calendar synchronization scheduler jobs.

methods.name: getActiveJobStatusCondition
methods.description: Returns a condition string to filter out completed jobs and deleted jobs in the job queue.

methods.name: getMeetingJobCondition
methods.description: Constructs a condition string to identify a specific meeting synchronization job based on job name and target.

methods.name: generateAccountJobName
methods.description: Creates a standardized job name for calendar account synchronization processes.

methods.name: generateMeetingJobName
methods.description: Creates a detailed job name for calendar sync meeting operations, including account ID, location, and event ID.
